sections.installation:
1. Install the Plugin from the WordPress Marketplace or upload the nexron-ai-chat folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Nexron AI Chat settings page to configure the plugin and set up/sign into your Nexron account.
  4. Enter your Nexron account details.
  5. After the free trail ensure you have sufficient credits to continue using the service.
sections.faq:
Can I test the plugin website visitors seeing the Nexron AI Chat?

Yes, setting the plugin mode to “Test” allows admin users to view and test the full functionality of the chatbot before releasing it to website visitors and users. Toggling between “Test” and “Live” mode can be done at any time on the plugin settings page.

Do I need a Nexron account to use this plugin?

Yes, a Nexron account is required to use the Nexron AI Chat plugin.

How do I get a Nexron account?

You can sign up for a free Nexron account on the Nexron AI Chat settings page on your WordPress website or alyternatively visit www.nexron.ai.

How do I configure the chatbot?

After activating the plugin, go to the Nexron AI Chat settings page in your WordPress admin dashboard. Enter your Nexron account details and configure the chatbot settings to match your website’s needs.

What happens if I run out of Nexron credits?

If you run out of credits, the chatbot functionality will be temporarily disabled until you purchase more credits through your Nexron account. Credits can be topped up at anytime.

What data does Nexron AI Chat Plugin send to Nexron AI?

The plugin may send website and visitor data to Nexron AI. This data is used for analysing and understanding the website and responsing to visitor queries.

Can I use the plugin without connecting to Nexron AI?

Features of Nexron AI Chat Plugin rely on Nexron AI services and will not function correctly if the service is not available or if you choose not to connect.
